traits.name: Ear of the Chosen
traits.desc: Whenever a creature on the same plane of existence as Alustriel speaks Alustriel's name, Alustriel hears her name and the next nine words the speaker utters.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Alustriel fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Alustriel carries a magic staff known as the Staff of Silverymoon. In the hands of anyone other than Alustriel, the Staff of Silverymoon is a Staff of Power.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Alustriel makes three Staff of Silverymoon attacks or two Reproving Ray attacks.

actions.name: Staff of Silverymoon
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 38 (7d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Reproving Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +14 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 65 (9d12 + 7) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it must make a DC 22 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the incapacitated condition until the start of Alustriel's next turn. On a successful save, the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of Alustriel's next turn.

actions.name: Argent Blaze (Requires Silver Fire)
actions.desc: Alustriel summons a 60-foot cone of silver fire. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 77 (14d10) radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, Alustriel or one creature of her choice within 60 feet of her then regains 10 (3d6) hit points.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Alustriel casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|Dancing Lights]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (self only), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|Detect Thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Tongues|Tongues]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Telepathy|Telepathy]], [[Tools/Spells/Teleport|Teleport]], [[Tools/Spells/Time Stop|Time Stop]]

bonus_actions.name: Silver Fire (2/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Brilliant silver fire harmlessly wreathes Alustriel and empowers her. The silver fire lasts for 1 hour or until she has the incapacitated condition or uses another bonus action to quench it. While wreathed in silver fire, Alustriel gains truesight within 30 feet and can use her Argent Blaze action. In addition, Alustriel is unaffected by magic that would ascertain her alignment, creature type, thoughts, or truthfulness.

reactions.name: Shining Counterspell
reactions.desc: Alustriel interrupts a creature she can see within 60 feet of herself that is casting a spell. If the spell is 5th level or lower, it fails and has no effect. If the spell is 6th level or higher, Alustriel makes an Intelligence check (DC 10 plus the spell's level). On a successful check, the spell fails and has no effect. Whatever the spell's level, the caster takes 11 (2d10) radiant damage if the spell fails.

sb.name: Argentia Skywright
sb.ac_class: in humanoid form; 12 (natural armor) in wolf or hybrid form
sb.damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: Argentia can use its action to polymorph into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a wolf, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.desc: Argentia has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Argentia makes two attacks: two with its spear (humanoid form) or one with its bite and one with its claws (hybrid form).

actions.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werewolf lycanthropy.

actions.name: Claws (Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

sb.name: Black Rose Bearer
sb.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Berserk
traits.desc: Whenever the bearer takes damage or makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, roll a d6. On a 5 or 6, the bearer goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the bearer has advantage on melee attack rolls, it can Dash as a bonus action, and it must attack the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the bearer attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the bearer goes berserk, it remains berserk until it is destroyed or its creator gives it a pristine black rose.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces the bearer to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a successful save, the bearer drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bearer makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The lieutenant has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lieutenant's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lieutenant makes three Longsword or Javelin Launcher attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 20 (3d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Javelin Launcher
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target has the prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Command Ally
bonus_actions.desc: The lieutenant targets one ally it can see within 30 feet of itself. If the target can see or hear the lieutenant, the target can make one melee attack using its reaction, if available, and has advantage on the attack roll.

bonus_actions.name: Rally the Troops (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The lieutenant ends the charmed and frightened conditions on itself and each creature of its choice that it can see within 30 feet of itself.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The lieutenant adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the lieutenant must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The scout has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the scout's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scout makes three Armblade or Bolt Launcher attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a use of Snare Trap.

actions.name: Armblade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bolt Launcher
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Snare Trap (1/Day)
actions.desc: The scout deploys a Tiny mechanical trap on a solid surface within 5 feet of itself. The trap is hidden, requiring a successful DC 17 Intelligence (Investigation) check to find. The trap lasts for 1 minute. Whenever an enemy enters a space within 10 feet of the trap or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) piercing damage and have the prone condition. A creature makes this saving throw only once per turn.

bonus_actions.name: Dash
bonus_actions.desc: The scout moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The blazebear has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Mist Sight
traits.desc: The blazebear can see normally through heavily obscured areas created by mist or fog, including areas created by spells such as Fog Cloud.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The blazebear makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with Stunning Gaze if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage.

actions.name: Stunning Gaze (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The blazebear targets two creatures it can see within 120 feet of itself. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of the blazebear's next turn.

reactions.name: Antimagic Swipe
reactions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature casting a spell of 3rd level or lower. Hit: 22 (4d10) force damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or the spell fails and has no effect.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bone roc makes one Beak attack and two Talons attacks.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

sb.name: Borthak

traits.name: Glacial Aura
traits.desc: At the end of the borthak's turn, slippery ice covers surfaces within 10 feet of the borthak. This ice is difficult terrain. When a creature other than the borthak enters the ice's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or have the prone condition. The ice disappears at the start of the borthak's next turn.

traits.name: Webbed Feet
traits.desc: The borthak can move across icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The borthak makes one Bite attack or uses Noxious Regurgitation if available, and it makes two Stomp attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Noxious Regurgitation (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The borthak spews acid at a creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 24 (7d6) acid damage and has the poisoned condition until the start of the borthak's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

reactions.name: Reactive Tail
reactions.desc: When a creature within 10 feet of the borthak hits the borthak with an attack roll, the borthak swings its tail in retaliation. The triggering creature and any creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: The borthak moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The borthak makes one Bite attack.

sb.damage_resistances: cold, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.desc: Camlash explodes when reduced to 0 hit points, and each creature within 30 feet of Camlash must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Camlash has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Aura
traits.desc: Camlash is surrounded by tiny biting spiders that magically appear and disappear from moment to moment. At the start of each of Camlash's turns, each creature within 10 feet of Camlash takes 10 (3d6) poison damage and must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have the paralyzed condition until the start of Camlash's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Camlash makes one Flaming Whip attack and one Lightning Blade attack. Camlash can replace one of these attacks with Teleport.

actions.name: Flaming Whip
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (5d6 + 8) fire damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward Camlash.

actions.name: Lightning Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: Camlash magically teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

sb.name: Citadel Spider
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 11

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the spider fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spider makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with a use of Web Bomb.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Web Bomb
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, range 300 ft./600 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage, and the target and all creatures within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) acid damage and have the restrained condition until the start of the spider's next turn.

reactions.name: Absorb Blow
reactions.desc: In response to being hit with an attack roll, the spider's carapace absorbs some of the blow, reducing the damage it takes by 11 (2d10).

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: Crunch has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of Crunch's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Crunch makes three Armblade or Bolt Launcher attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a use of Snare Trap.

actions.name: Armblade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bolt Launcher
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Snare Trap (1/Day)
actions.desc: Crunch deploys a Tiny mechanical trap on a solid surface within 5 feet of itself. The trap is hidden, requiring a successful DC 17 Intelligence (Investigation) check to find. The trap lasts for 1 minute. Whenever an enemy enters a space within 10 feet of the trap or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) piercing damage and have the prone condition. A creature makes this saving throw only once per turn.

bonus_actions.name: Dash
bonus_actions.desc: Crunch moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

sb.name: Deadbark Dryad
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Bramble Walk
traits.desc: Difficult terrain composed of vegetation, such as foliage or thorns, doesn't cost the dryad extra movement.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.desc: The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dryad makes two Poisonous Thorn attacks and one Sapping Vine attack.

actions.name: Poisonous Thorn
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (4d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition until the start of the dryad's next turn.

actions.name: Sapping Vine
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: The target has the grappled condition (escape DC 16). Until the grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the dryad can't use the same vine on another target. A creature restrained in this way takes 13 (3d8) necrotic damage at the start of its turn. The dryad has six vines. Each vine can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Destroying a vine deals no damage to the dryad, but any creature grappled by that vine no longer has the grappled condition. All vines immediately wither and disappear when the dryad is reduced to 0 hit points.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The dryad casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Druidcraft|Druidcraft]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Pass Without Trace|Pass without Trace]], [[Tools/Spells/Spike Growth|Spike Growth]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]]

sb.name: Deathwolf
sb.damage_immunities: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If the deathwolf fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Moon's Grace
traits.desc: When the deathwolf falls, it descends at a rate of 60 feet per round and takes no falling damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The deathwolf makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Phantom Deathwolf if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on saving throws against the frightened condition. This curse lasts until removed by the [[Tools/Spells/Remove Curse|Remove Curse]] spell or other magic.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Phantom Deathwolf (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The deathwolf creates a terrifying phantom of itself in the mind of a creature the deathwolf can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or have the frightened condition for 1 minute. While the target is frightened, the phantom deals 21 (6d6) psychic damage to the target at the start of each of the target's turns. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reactions.desc: The deathwolf can take up to two reactions per round but only one per turn.

reactions.name: Imposing Slash
reactions.desc: When a creature within 5 feet of the deathwolf makes an attack roll against it, the deathwolf forces the creature to succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on that roll. After the attack hits or misses, the deathwolf makes one Claw attack against the creature.

reactions.name: Phase Step
reactions.desc: Immediately after taking damage, the deathwolf teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see that is in dim light or darkness.

sb.name: Degloth
sb.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The degloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The degloth makes two Razor Fist attacks.

actions.name: Razor Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the target has the grappled condition (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the degloth can't use this fist to grapple another target. The degloth has two fists.

bonus_actions.name: Crush
bonus_actions.desc: The degloth targets one creature currently grappled by it. The target must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw, taking 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Divine Eminence
traits.desc: As a bonus action, Eldon can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If Eldon expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Eldon is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). Eldon has the following cleric spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Sacred Flame|sacred flame]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|thaumaturgy]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|cure wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Guiding Bolt|guiding bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Sanctuary|sanctuary]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|lesser restoration]], [[Tools/Spells/Spiritual Weapon|spiritual weapon]]
- **3rd level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Spirit Guardians|spirit guardians]]

sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Magic Resistance

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The false lich makes two Death Rend attacks and uses Bloodcurdling Lament if available.

actions.name: Death Rend
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Bloodcurdling Lament (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The false lich emits a hideous shriek charged with malignant energy. Each creature within 30 feet of the false lich must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, a creature also has the unconscious condition. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The false lich casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Fly|Fly]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|Prestidigitation]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|Invisibility]] (self only)
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Globe Of Invulnerability|Globe of Invulnerability]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Monster|Hold Monster]]

bonus_actions.name: Soul Siphon
bonus_actions.desc: The false lich targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 22 Charisma saving throw; if the target has the unconscious condition, it has disadvantage on this saving throw. The target takes 21 (6d6) force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The false lich then regains a number of hit points equal to the amount of force damage taken. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target immediately dies, its body disappears, and its soul is trapped inside one of the soul gems within the false lich's skull. After 24 hours, the gem transfers the soul to the false lich's creator. When the false lich is reduced to 0 hit points, it is destroyed and disintegrates, leaving behind the gems. Crushing a gem releases any souls trapped within, at which point the soul's body re-forms in an unoccupied space nearest to the gem and in the same state as it was when its soul was trapped.

legendary_actions.name: Spiteful Teleport
legendary_actions.desc: The false lich, along with anything it is wearing or carrying, teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of itself. It then makes one Death Rend attack if possible.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The false lich uses Spellcasting.

sb.languages: any four languages, Gnomish, Terran, Undercommon

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.desc: Grottenelle has advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Stone Camouflage

actions.desc: The hazvongel launches a spray of blood in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

sb.name: Hertilod
sb.damage_resistances: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 18

traits.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the hertilod fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The hertilod has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Shock Susceptibility
traits.desc: If the hertilod takes lightning damage, its speed is halved until the end of its next turn, and it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or immediately regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which lands in a space within 10 feet of the hertilod and has the prone condition.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The hertilod can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hertilod makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) poison damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be swallowed by the hertilod. A swallowed creature has the blinded and restrained conditions, and it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the hertilod. At the start of each of the hertilod's turns, each swallowed creature takes 13 (2d12) poison damage from the poisonous secretion in the hertilod's gullet. The hertilod's gullet can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the hertilod takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a swallowed creature, the hertilod must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which lands in a space within 10 feet of the hertilod and has the prone condition. If the hertilod dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.

legendary_actions.name: Sprint
legendary_actions.desc: The hertilod moves up to its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Feed (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The hertilod drains life from the creatures in its gullet to bolster itself. Each creature in the hertilod's gullet takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the hertilod regains a number of hit points equal to the damage.

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.desc: Inda's weapon attacks are magical. When Inda hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Inda makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Mace

actions.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: Inda magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Inda's choice). In a new form, Inda retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Indrina adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Indrina must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Jerot makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Jerot casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Bestow Curse|bestow curse]], [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|dimension door]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]], [[Tools/Spells/Web|web]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Circle Of Death|circle of death]]

bonus_actions.name: Summon Undead (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Jerot magically summons five skeletons or zombies. The summoned creatures appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of Jerot, whom they obey. They take their turns immediately after Jerot. Each lasts for 1 hour, until it or Jerot dies, or until Jerot dismisses it as a bonus action.

reactions.name: Grim Harvest (1/Turn)
reactions.desc: When Jerot kills a creature with necrotic damage, Jerot regains 9 (2d8) hit points.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The kakkuu can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.desc: When in contact with a web, the kakkuu knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The kakkuu ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kakkuu makes a Web Snare attack, uses Reel, and makes a Bite attack.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Reel
actions.desc: The kakkuu pulls each creature within 60 feet of itself that is grappled by its Web Snare up to 30 feet straight toward itself.

actions.name: Web Snare
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The target has the grappled condition (escape DC 13). While grappled, the target also has the restrained condition. A web snare grappling a creature can be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; 10 hit points; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

sb.name: Kas the Betrayer
sb.damage_immunities: necrotic, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Eager Betrayer
traits.desc: Kas adds 1d10 to his initiative rolls. He has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that has the frightened condition.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Kas fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Kas regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Kas wears the Crown of Lies (see the Introduction of Vecna: Eve of Ruin).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: Kas can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Strength of the Night
traits.desc: Kas doesn't require a coffin, and he drinks blood to sow terror rather than for sustenance. If destroyed, Kas revives in 1d100 nights in an unoccupied space in Tovag, his Domain of Dread. He can be permanently destroyed only by having a stake driven through his heart and then being beheaded. The stake must be cut from a tree growing in soil from Oerth, Kas's home world.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, Kas takes 20 radiant damage at the start of his turn, has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and can't use his Change Shape bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Kas makes three Vengeful Sword attacks. He can replace one of these attacks with a Bite attack.

actions.name: Vengeful Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d8 + 11) slashing damage. The sword scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (1d6 + 8) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Kas regains a number of hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Kas's control.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: Kas transforms into a Medium cloud of mist. While in this form, Kas has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. While in mist form, Kas can pass through a space without squeezing as long as air can pass through that space, but he can't pass through water. Kas has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and he is immune to all nonmagical damage except the damage he takes as part of his Vampire Weaknesses trait. While in mist form, Kas can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects.

bonus_actions.name: Menacing Glare
bonus_actions.desc: Kas targets one creature he can see within 60 feet of himself. The target must succeed on a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until the start of Kas's next turn.

reactions.name: Parrying Riposte
reactions.desc: Kas adds 3 to his AC against one melee attack roll that would hit him. He then makes one Vengeful Sword attack against the attacker if it is within his reach. On a hit, the target takes an additional 9 (2d8) slashing damage.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: Kas moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Sword (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Kas makes one Vengeful Sword attack.

legendary_actions.name: Rise, Fallen Soldier (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Kas magically summons a specter. The specter appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of Kas, whom it obeys. The specter takes its turn immediately after Kas. It lasts for 1 hour, until Kas dies, or until Kas dismisses it as a bonus action. Kas can't have more than two specters summoned at a time.

sb.name: Kaylan Renaudon
sb.damage_resistances: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: If Kaylan isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form. While in bat form, Kaylan can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies. While in mist form, Kaylan can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Kaylan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Misty Escape
traits.desc: When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, Kaylan transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed. While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Kaylan regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Kaylan takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of Kaylan's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: Kaylan can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc:
Kaylan has the following flaws:

- **Forbiddance.** Kaylan can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.
- **Harmed by Running Water.** Kaylan takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.
- **Stake to the Heart.** If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Kaylan's heart while Kaylan is incapacitated in its resting place, Kaylan is paralyzed until the stake is removed.
- **Sunlight Hypersensitivity.** Kaylan takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: Kaylan makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Kaylan can grapple the target (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by Kaylan, incapacitated, or restrained. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Kaylan regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Kaylan's control.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc: Kaylan targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see Kaylan, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by Kaylan. The charmed target regards Kaylan as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Kaylan's control, it takes Kaylan's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for Kaylan's bite attack. Each time Kaylan or Kaylan's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Kaylan is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

actions.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
actions.desc: Kaylan magically calls 2d4 swarms of bats or rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, Kaylan can call 3d6 wolves instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of Kaylan and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Kaylan dies, or until Kaylan dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: Kaylan moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Unarmed Strike
legendary_actions.desc: Kaylan makes one unarmed strike.

legendary_actions.desc: Kaylan makes one bite attack.

actions.name: Sorrowful Embrace
actions.desc: Each creature grappled by Kevetta must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In either case, Kevetta pulls each of those creatures up to 30 feet straight toward it.

traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Khai's darkvision.

actions.desc: Khai makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack, and it can use Frightful Presence or Incite Fanaticism.

actions.desc: Each creature of Khai's choice that is within 120 feet and aware of Khai must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of it for 1 minute. actions.name: Power of the Dragon Queen
actions.desc: Khai targets one Dragon it can see within 120 feet of it. The Dragon must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. A chromatic dragon makes this save with disadvantage. sb.languages: Thieves' cant plus any two languages

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If Laysa is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, Laysa instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: Laysa deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Laysa that isn't incapacitated and Laysa doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: If Sangora isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form. While in bat form, Sangora can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies. While in mist form, Sangora can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Sangora fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Misty Escape
traits.desc: When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, Sangora transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed. While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

actions.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)

The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Sangora regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. Each time Sangora or Sangora's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. traits.desc:
Vaeve's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Darkness|darkness]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|faerie fire]], [[Tools/Spells/Levitate|levitate]] (self only)

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Vaeve is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). Vaeve has the following wizard spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]], [[Tools/Spells/Poison Spray|poison spray]], [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Frost|ray of frost]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]], [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]], [[Tools/Spells/Shield|shield]], [[Tools/Spells/Witch Bolt|witch bolt]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Alter Self|alter self]], [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]], [[Tools/Spells/Web|web]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Fly|fly]], [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|lightning bolt]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Evard'S Black Tentacles|Evard's black tentacles]], [[Tools/Spells/Greater Invisibility|greater invisibility]]
- **5th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Cloudkill|cloudkill]]

actions.name: Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Summon Demon (1/Day)
actions.desc: Vaeve magically summons a quasit, or attempts to summon a shadow demon with a 50 percent chance of success. The summoned demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of its summoner, acts as an ally of its summoner, and can't summon other demons. It remains for 10 minutes, until it or its summoner dies, or until its summoner dismisses it as an action.

sb.name: Valendar
sb.ac_class: in humanoid form; 12 (natural armor) in wolf or hybrid form
sb.damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: Valendar can use its action to polymorph into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a wolf, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.desc: Valendar has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Valendar makes two attacks: two with its spear (humanoid form) or one with its bite and one with its claws (hybrid form).

actions.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werewolf lycanthropy.

actions.name: Claws (Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

sb.name: Vecna the Archlich
sb.damage_immunities: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.desc: If Vecna fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Vecna carries a magic dagger named Afterthought. In the hands of anyone other than Vecna, Afterthought is a +2 Dagger.

traits.name: Undying
traits.desc: If Vecna is slain, his soul refuses to accept its fate and lives on as a disembodied spirit that fashions a new body for itself after 1d100 years. Vecna's new body appears within 100 miles of where he was slain. When the new body is complete, Vecna regains all his hit points and becomes active again.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Vecna uses Flight of the Damned (if available), Rotten Fate, or Spellcasting. He then makes two attacks with Afterthought.

actions.name: Afterthought
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is afflicted by entropic magic, taking 9 (2d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. Immediately after taking this damage on its turn, the target must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Until it succeeds on this save, the afflicted target can't regain hit points.

actions.name: Flight of the Damned (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Vecna conjures a torrent of flying, spectral entities that fill a 120-foot cone and pass through all creatures in that area before dissipating. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage and has the frightened condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Rotten Fate
actions.desc: Vecna causes necrotic magic to engulf one creature he can see within 120 feet of himself. The target must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 96 (8d8 + 60) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A Humanoid killed by this magic rises as a zombie at the start of Vecna's next turn and acts immediately after Vecna in the initiative order. The zombie is under Vecna's control.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Vecna casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Animate Dead|Animate Dead]] (as an action), [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Fly|Fly]], [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|Lightning Bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|Prestidigitation]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|Dimension Door]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|Invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]] (as an action)
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Monster|Dominate Monster]], [[Tools/Spells/Globe Of Invulnerability|Globe of Invulnerability]], [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|Plane Shift]] (self only)

bonus_actions.name: Vile Teleport
bonus_actions.desc: Vecna teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. He can cause each creature of his choice within 15 feet of his destination space to take 10 (3d6) psychic damage. If at least one creature takes this damage, Vecna regains 80 hit points.

reactions.desc: Vecna can take up to three reactions per round but only one per turn.

reactions.name: Dread Counterspell
reactions.desc: Vecna utters a dread word to interrupt a creature he can see that is casting a spell. If the spell is 4th level or lower, it fails and has no effect. If the spell is 5th level or higher, Vecna makes an Intelligence check (DC 10 plus the spell's level). On a successful check, the spell fails and has no effect. Whatever the spell's level, the caster takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage if the spell fails.

reactions.name: Fell Rebuke
reactions.desc: In response to being hit by an attack, Vecna utters a fell word, dealing 10 (3d6) necrotic damage to the attacker, and Vecna teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

traits.name: All-Around Vision
traits.desc: The vlazok can't be surprised.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.desc: The vlazok has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The vlazok has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The vlazok can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vlazok makes two Gore attacks.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) piercing damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Stomp
bonus_actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The warforged makes two Armblade attacks.

actions.name: Armblade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Protection
reactions.desc: When an attacker the warforged can see makes an attack roll against a creature within 5 feet of the warforged, the warforged can impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

sb.name: Whirling Chandelier
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 7

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: If the chandelier is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the chandelier move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the chandelier is animate.

traits.name: Fiery Aura
traits.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the chandelier takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The chandelier makes three Chain attacks, three Lamp attacks, or a combination thereof.

actions.name: Chain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the chandelier.

actions.name: Lamp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Blazing Vortex (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Each creature within 20 feet of the chandelier and not behind total cover must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 36 (8d8) fire damage and have the blinded condition until the start of the chandelier's next turn.

sb.name: Windfall

traits.name: Dazzling Visage
traits.desc: A brilliant array of chromatic colors emanates from Windfall, causing attack rolls against her to have disadvantage. This trait ceases to function while Windfall has the incapacitated condition or has a speed of 0.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Windfall fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Windfall wears an iridescent magic coat that was tailored specifically for her and imbued with Tiamat's power. When she dies, the coat functions as a Robe of Scintillating Colors.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Windfall makes two Chromatic Rapier attacks and uses Dragon's Fury once.

actions.name: Chromatic Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage (Windfall's choice).

actions.name: Dragon's Fury
actions.desc: Windfall targets one creature she can see within 60 feet of herself and unleashes a burst of magical ire. The target must make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 36 (8d8) psychic damage and has the frightened condition until the start of Windfall's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Windfall casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 23):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Light|Light]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|Thaumaturgy]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Shatter|Shatter]], [[Tools/Spells/Unseen Servant|Unseen Servant]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Hypnotic Pattern|Hypnotic Pattern]], [[Tools/Spells/Sending|Sending]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Hold Monster|Hold Monster]]

bonus_actions.name: Stunning Scintillation (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: Windfall emits an overwhelming array of colors from her coat. Each creature within 30 feet of Windfall that can see her must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of Windfall's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Deft Dance
legendary_actions.desc: Windfall moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Dragon's Flare
legendary_actions.desc: Windfall flares with multicolored flames and targets a creature she can see within 30 feet of herself. The target must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 26 (4d12) damage of a type chosen by Windfall: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Windfall uses Spellcasting.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
traits.desc:
Zastra's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]] (the hand is invisible)
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Jump|jump]], [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]], [[Tools/Spells/Nondetection|nondetection]] (self only), [[Tools/Spells/Tongues|tongues]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|plane shift]], [[Tools/Spells/Telekinesis|telekinesis]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Zastra makes two silver greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Silver Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage. This is a magic weapon attack. On a critical hit against a target in an astral body (as with the [[Tools/Spells/Astral Projection|astral projection]] spell), Zastra can cut the silvery cord that tethers the target to its material body, instead of dealing damage.
